}}'''Jesamyn''' is a member of the [[Kin]] serving as a Healer in [[Caemlyn]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jesamyn}}

==Appearance and abilities==
Jesamyn is a youthful looking woman with gold-colored hair.{{ref/book|14|p}}

She is weak in the [[One Power]], requiring three other roughly equally weak women to create a [[gateway]].{{ref/book|14|p}} That means she is quite weak, as some weaker Aes Sedai of middling strength can form a gateway with only two sisters linked.

Despite her weakness she has a talent in the [[healing]] weaves and also she is very effective killing Trollocs with [[fire]] weaves.

==Activities==
Jesamyn and only three other [[Kinswomen]] were left in [[Caemlyn]] when [[Elayne]] went to the gathering at [[Merrilor]]. None of them could made a gateway on her own, but they could when linked together.

During the [[Siege of Caemlyn]], some [[darkfriend]]s killed two of the other Kinswomen and another was dispersed in the fights so Jesamyn was unable to send a message to the Queen.

Later she helped captain [[Charlz Guybon]] to reach the [[Band of the Red Hand]], attacking the [[Trollocs]] with the One Power.

Then Jesamyn attempted to heal [[Talmanes Delovinde]] of his wound from a [[Thakan'dar]]-forged blade. The [[Healing]], though, was beyond her skill.{{ref/book|14|p}}

Despite being weak with the One Power, she was very useful and not harmless, having been seen to destroy six Trollocs on her own.

She was with the Band of the Red Hand when they turned the [[Dragons]] on [[Caemlyn]]'s walls and blew a hole in them, through which they escaped.

== Trivia ==
* Jesamyn is named for Jesamyn Angelica, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
